description: Bitcoin: Get the next confirmed transactions strictly older than `after_txid`, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most); a txid outside the address's history answers `[]` (Esplora-canonical pagination form, matches mempool.space).

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

after_txid.description: Last txid from the previous page (return transactions strictly older than this)

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 25 (the default); larger values return 25.

name: get_address_confirmed_txs_after
title: Address confirmed transactions (paginated)
